text:
Jonah: Heads-up — looks like ~12 hours of late telemetry for /api/generate. Pinpointed to an overloaded consumer group in eu-west, retry storm. We should plan a controlled recompute, not a big hammer.
Maya: ugh. do you have a dashboard link and sample query? want to see the distribution by hour.
Jonah: https://dash.redwood.gg/d/telemetry/ingest-latency?orgId=1&var-service=api
Jonah: sample ES query: `service:api AND event:/api/generate AND ingest_ts < event_ts - 5m`
Priya: I saw the same in Kafka offsets — several partitions stalled then replayed. Proposing we use airflow DAG `telemetry_recompute_v2` with throttling. Full backfill will read ~200M rows, ~15TB S3. cost + quotas heads-up.
Alex: Safety checklist: 1) run dry-run mode to verify dedupe keys 2) add rate-limit to backfill (<= 5% of normal ingest IO) 3) annotate dashboards so product doesn't panic.
Sam: Please annotate dashboards. Also we need to ensure rollouts UX doesn't surface inflated metrics to customers while recompute runs — maybe hide the "live" tag or add an "stale-data" banner.
Jonah: Proposed plan: 1) dry-run on a 1-hour window, 2) canary backfill for 1% of partitions, 3) ramp by 5x every 2h if no anomalies. We'll set SLO-aware throttle to not exceed 95th p50 IO.
Priya: Backfill command (airflow):
```
airflow dags trigger telemetry_recompute_v2 \
  --conf '{"start":"2026-03-15T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-03-15T12:00:00Z","throttle_qps":200,"dry_run":true}'
```
Priya: also want to tag runs with `backfill-batch=eu-west-20260315` so we can filter in the console.
backfill-bot: Created backfill tag backfill-batch=eu-west-20260315 and recorded estimate=200M_rows
Alex: Also add tenant-aware quotas so a single heavy tenant doesn't saturate downstream aggregation. We need dedupe key check: if recompute writes overlap with live, ensure upsert semantics by (tenant,event_id) keys.
Maya: I'll add a dashboard annotation and create an "In-progress backfill" banner in the console for internal only. Will also add a metric for backfill-ingested_bytes so ops can watch throttles.
Priya: I will run the dry-run tonight. Requesting temporary bump to S3 read quota and a short-term raise to the Kafka consumer limit; estimate ~3x baseline for 2 hours. tagging owners: @Alex for infra quota, @Jonah for job params.
Jonah: Approved dry-run. Priya please post the dry-run logs and the recompute validation check when done. Validation SQL example:
```
SELECT count(*) as recomputed, count(distinct event_id) as unique_events FROM telemetry_recompute
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-15' AND '2026-03-15 12:00:00';
```
Alex: I'll pre-approve the quota bump for dry-run window. Real run needs on-call signoff though. Also let's add a guard to abort if error_rate > 0.5% for any 5m window.
Sam: Once dry-run looks good please coordinate with growth so they don't run experiments that would confuse the dashboards. We should also create a short postmortem doc for why the retry storm happened.
Priya: Will do dry-run, will upload logs to gs://redwood-backfill/logs/eu-west-20260315 and ping here. If dry-run ok, I'll flip `dry_run=false` and trigger the canary with throttle_qps=500.
airflow-bot: DAG telemetry_recompute_v2 triggered by Jonah (run_id=manual__2026-03-18T22:10:03, conf=start=2026-03-15T00:00:00Z,end=2026-03-15T12:00:00Z,dry_run=true)
Jonah: ok thanks. keep updates short in this thread only. let's avoid diffs in the console schema while recompute runs (no structural writes).
